BiliExtract's dedicated audio engine detects the isolated audio stream encoded in AAC / MP4A format inside Bilibili's DASH stream manifest, bypassing video bloat to deliver pure, high-fidelity sound.

Frequently Asked Questions

Got Questions? We've Got Answers

Everything you need to know about extracting Bilibili video, audio, and subtitle streams.

What audio bitrate do you extract from Bilibili videos?

We extract the maximum available audio stream quality directly from Bilibili's DASH manifest, up to 320 kbps (High Fidelity) and 192 kbps studio audio, with fallback to standard 128 kbps.

Can I extract audio from anime songs and gaming streams?

Yes, any public Bilibili music video, anime OST, vocaloid track, or live stream VOD can be converted to MP3/M4A.

Is there any audio compression or loss of quality during conversion?

No re-encoding compression is performed. You receive the exact untouched high-bitrate AAC/MP4A stream as uploaded by the content creator.
